name: What unique issues occur during shower remodels in Denver-area homes?

mainEntity.name: What unique issues occur during shower remodels in Denver-area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver and nearby suburban homes, older properties often have narrow galvanized or copper piping, settling foundations, and subfloors that require leveling before tile can be set. Older neighborhoods in Denver, Centennial, or Englewood frequently reveal subfloor movement or out-of-square framing during demolition, which must be corrected with fresh sistered joists or leveling compounds before laying rigid shower tile. In regional homes with basements, concrete slab penetrations for drain relocations also require specialized trenching and careful moisture mitigation compared to standard wood-framed second-story bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older homes in the Denver area frequently have out-of-level subfloors and older plumbing lines that require structural shoring and pipe upgrades before setting new tile.
